source.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: For the director. A psalm of David.

en.L: For the director. A psalm of David.
en.B: For the music director. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur. Un psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Wimbo wa Daudi.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: "Au chef de chœur" at Literal and Balanced, "Pour le chef des musiciens" at Readable, for lamnatseach, for the whole block
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note sets. The word names the one who leads the temple music; its exact office is not known.

decisions.choice: "Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya" (L, B); "Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji" (R), for the director in the titles of these psalms
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the one who led the temple music. "Kiongozi wa kwaya" is the leader of a choir, which every church reader knows; Readable says "the leader of the singers", the plainest words.

source.text: בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל־אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: In you, YHWH, I have taken refuge; let me not be put to shame forever; in your righteousness deliver me.

en.L: In {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I have taken refuge; let me not be put to shame forever; in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness rescue me.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I have made {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} my refuge; never let me be disgraced; because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are righteous, set me free.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I have run to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for safety. Never let me be ashamed. You always do what is right, so save me.

fr.L: En {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai cherché refuge ; que je ne sois jamais couvert de honte ; dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice, délivre-moi.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai fait de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} mon refuge ; ne permets pas que je sois jamais humilié ; parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es juste, libère-moi.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai couru vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour être à l’abri. Ne me laisse jamais avoir honte. Tu fais toujours ce qui est juste : alors sauve-moi.

sw.L: Kwako, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimekimbilia; nisiaibike milele; kwa haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} uniponye.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimekufanya {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kuwa kimbilio langu; usiniache niaibishwe kamwe; kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwenye haki, uniweke huru.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimekukimbilia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ili niwe salama. Usiniache niaibike kamwe. Wewe hutenda yaliyo sawa siku zote, kwa hiyo uniokoe.

decisions.choice: your righteousness: your faithfulness to do right
decisions.reason: God's righteousness (tsedaqah) is his faithfulness to do what is right, which for his people means rescue (5:9; 71:2).

decisions.choice: verses 2-4: repeated in Psalm 71
decisions.reason: Psalm 71:1-3 repeats these lines almost word for word.

decisions.choice: taken refuge
decisions.reason: As in 25:20.

source.text: הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨י׀אָזְנְךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י׀לְֽצוּר־מָ֭עוֹז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Incline to me your ear, quickly deliver me; be to me a rock of refuge, a house of strongholds to save me.

en.L: Incline {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear to me; quickly rescue me; be to me a rock of refuge, a house of fortresses to save me.
en.B: Bend down and listen to me; hurry to rescue me. Be a rock where I can shelter, a fortified house that keeps me safe.
en.R: Listen to me, and hurry to rescue me! Be like a big rock where I can hide. Be like a strong fort that keeps me safe.

fr.L: Incline vers moi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} oreille ; vite, délivre-moi ; sois pour moi un rocher de refuge, une maison de forteresses pour me sauver.
fr.B: Penche-toi vers moi et écoute ; hâte-toi de me délivrer. Sois le rocher où je m’abrite, la maison fortifiée qui me garde en sûreté.
fr.R: Écoute-moi, et viens vite me délivrer ! Sois comme un grand rocher où je peux me cacher. Sois comme un fort solide qui me protège.

sw.L: Unitegee sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; uniponye upesi; uwe kwangu mwamba wa kimbilio, nyumba ya ngome za kuniokoa.
sw.B: Uiname unisikilize; harakisha kuniokoa. Uwe mwamba ninaoweza kujificha kwake, nyumba yenye ngome inayonilinda salama.
sw.R: Unisikilize, na uharakishe kuniokoa! Uwe kama mwamba mkubwa ninaoweza kujificha nyuma yake. Uwe kama ngome imara inayonilinda salama.

decisions.choice: incline your ear: bend down to listen
decisions.reason: The picture is of someone bending close to hear a weak voice (17:6; 71:2).

decisions.choice: a rock of refuge, a house of strongholds: a fortress
decisions.reason: Both pictures are of a high, walled place where enemies cannot reach (18:3).

decisions.choice: Bend down
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of the idiom but says it plainly (m1).

source.text: כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָ֑תָּה וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: For my rock and my fortress [are] you, and for the sake of your name you will lead me and guide me.

en.L: For my rock and my fortress [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; and for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will lead me and guide me.
en.B: You {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} are my rock and my stronghold; for the honor of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will lead me and show me the way.
en.R: You are my rock and my safe place. You will lead me and guide me, to show what kind of God {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are.

fr.L: Car mon rocher et ma forteresse, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; et à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me conduiras et me guideras.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi-même|Toi-même}} qui es mon rocher et ma citadelle ; pour l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me conduiras et me montreras le chemin.
fr.R: Tu es mon rocher et mon lieu sûr. Tu me conduiras et me guideras, pour montrer quel Dieu {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es.

sw.L: Kwa maana mwamba wangu na ngome yangu [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; na kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} utaniongoza na kuniongoza njia.
sw.B: Wewe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} ni mwamba wangu na ngome yangu; kwa heshima ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} utaniongoza na kunionyesha njia.
sw.R: Wewe ni mwamba wangu na mahali pangu salama. Utaniongoza na kunielekeza, ili kuonyesha jinsi ulivyo Mungu wa namna gani.

decisions.choice: you: you and no other
decisions.reason: The pronoun is added for emphasis.

decisions.choice: you will lead me: confidence, or a request
alternatives: lead me and guide me (a request)
decisions.reason: The verbs can state what God will do or ask him to do it.

decisions.choice: for the sake of your name
decisions.reason: As in 25:11.

decisions.choice: to show what kind of God you are
alternatives: for the sake of your name
decisions.reason: As in 25:11.

source.text: תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּֽי־אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: You will bring me out from [the] net which they hid for me, for you [are] my refuge.

en.L: You will bring me out of the net that they have hidden for me, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] my stronghold.
en.B: You will free me from the net they have secretly laid for me, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are my stronghold.
en.R: My enemies have hidden a trap to catch me, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will get me out of it. You are the one who keeps me safe.

fr.L: Tu me feras sortir du filet qu’ils ont caché pour moi, car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] ma forteresse.
fr.B: Tu me libéreras du filet qu’on m’a tendu en secret, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es ma forteresse.
fr.R: Mes ennemis ont caché un piège pour m’attraper, mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’en feras sortir. C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui me gardes à l’abri.

sw.L: Utanitoa katika wavu ambao wamenifichia, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ni] ngome yangu.
sw.B: Utaniweka huru kutoka katika wavu walionitegea kwa siri, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni ngome yangu.
sw.R: Adui zangu wameficha mtego ili kunikamata, lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utanitoa ndani yake. Wewe ndiye unayenilinda salama.

decisions.choice: the net they hid: a hidden trap
decisions.reason: As in 25:15, a hunter's net laid out of sight (9:16).

decisions.choice: stronghold: a place of safety
decisions.reason: As in 27:1.

decisions.choice: My enemies
decisions.reason: Readable names who "they" are.

source.text: בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, YHWH, God of faithfulness.

en.L: Into {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand I commit my spirit; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have redeemed me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of truth.
en.B: I put my spirit into {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand for safekeeping; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have redeemed me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God who is faithful.
en.R: I put my life into {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands to keep it safe. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have rescued me. You are the God who is always faithful.

fr.L: Dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main je remets mon esprit ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as racheté, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu de vérité.
fr.B: Je confie mon esprit à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le gardes ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as racheté, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu fidèle.
fr.R: Je mets ma vie entre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} la gardes. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as délivré. Tu es le Dieu qui est toujours fidèle.

sw.L: Mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}} ninaikabidhi roho yangu; umenikomboa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa kweli.
sw.B: Ninaiweka roho yangu mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}} uitunze; umenikomboa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu aliye mwaminifu.
sw.R: Ninayaweka maisha yangu mikononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}} uyalinde. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeniokoa. Wewe ni Mungu aliye mwaminifu siku zote.

decisions.choice: Into your hand I commit my spirit: words of Jesus on the cross
decisions.reason: Jesus prayed these words as he died (Luke 23:46), and Stephen prayed in the same way (Acts 7:59). Here the psalmist entrusts his life to God in danger.

decisions.choice: commit: entrust for safekeeping
decisions.reason: The verb (hifqid) is to hand something over to be kept safe, as a deposit.

decisions.choice: God of truth: the faithful God
decisions.reason: The word ('emet) is reliability, as in 25:5: a God who keeps his word.

decisions.choice: you have redeemed me: certain as if done
decisions.reason: The past form speaks of the rescue as certain, or looks back on earlier rescues.

source.text: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: I hate those who keep vanities of emptiness, and I, in YHWH I trust.

en.L: I have hated those who keep empty vanities; but I — in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I have trusted.
en.B: I hate those who devote themselves to useless idols; but my trust is in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I hate it when people worship idols that cannot help them. But I trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: J’ai haï ceux qui s’attachent à des vanités vides ; mais moi, en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} j’ai eu confiance.
fr.B: Je déteste ceux qui se dévouent à des idoles inutiles ; mais ma confiance est en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je déteste voir des gens adorer des idoles qui ne peuvent pas les aider. Mais moi, j’ai confiance en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nimewachukia wale wanaoshika ubatili mtupu; lakini mimi, katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nimetumaini.
sw.B: Ninawachukia wale wanaojitoa kwa sanamu zisizofaa kitu; lakini tumaini langu liko kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ninachukia watu wanapoabudu sanamu zisizoweza kuwasaidia. Lakini mimi ninamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: I hate: the Hebrew text
alternatives: you hate (the ancient Greek translation and some Hebrew manuscripts)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "I hate". The ancient Greek translation and some Hebrew manuscripts read "you hate", addressed to God. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: empty vanities: worthless idols
decisions.reason: The words (havle shav') are "breaths of emptiness", a name for idols, which have no substance and cannot save (Deuteronomy 32:21).

decisions.choice: keep: pay regard to, devote themselves to
decisions.reason: To keep (shamar) idols is to honor and serve them.

source.text: אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת־עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: I will rejoice and be glad in your loyal love, because you have seen my affliction; you have known [the] troubles of my soul.

en.L: I will rejoice and be glad in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have seen my affliction; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have known the distresses of my soul.
en.B: I will be full of joy and delight because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} saw how I suffered and took notice of the troubles I was in.
en.R: I will be very happy because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love. You saw how I was suffering. You knew all about my troubles.

fr.L: Je jubilerai et je me réjouirai de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as vu ma misère ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as connu les détresses de mon âme.
fr.B: Je serai plein de joie et d’allégresse à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as vu combien je souffrais et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as remarqué les détresses où j’étais.
fr.R: Je serai très heureux à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle. Tu as vu que je souffrais. Tu savais tout de mes malheurs.

sw.L: Nitashangilia na kufurahi katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, kwa sababu umeyaona mateso yangu; umeyajua masumbuko ya nafsi yangu.
sw.B: Nitajawa na furaha na shangwe kwa sababu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, kwa maana uliona jinsi nilivyoteseka, ukazijali taabu nilizokuwa nazo.
sw.R: Nitafurahi sana kwa sababu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma. Uliona jinsi nilivyokuwa nikiteseka. Ulijua taabu zangu zote.

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps its commitments, the faithful kindness of the covenant (Exodus 34:6-7).

decisions.choice: you have known: you have cared about
decisions.reason: To know (yada') here is to take notice and care, as in 1:6.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: Readable's usual wording for chesed (m1).

source.text: וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And you did not shut me up in [the] hand of an enemy; you made my feet stand in the broad place.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not handed me over into the hand of [the] enemy; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have set my feet in a broad place.
en.B: You did not give me up into the power of my enemy; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have set my feet down in a wide-open place.
en.R: You did not let my enemy catch me. You let me walk free in a wide-open place.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne m’as pas livré dans la main de [l’]ennemi ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as placé mes pieds dans un lieu spacieux.
fr.B: Tu ne m’as pas abandonné au pouvoir de mon ennemi ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as posé mes pieds dans un lieu largement ouvert.
fr.R: Tu n’as pas laissé mon ennemi m’attraper. Tu me laisses marcher librement dans un grand espace.

sw.L: Wala hukunitia katika mkono wa adui; umeisimamisha miguu yangu mahali papana.
sw.B: Hukuniachilia katika nguvu za adui yangu; umeiweka miguu yangu mahali palipo wazi na pana.
sw.R: Hukumwacha adui yangu anikamate. Umeniwezesha kutembea huru mahali palipo wazi.

decisions.choice: the hand of an enemy: the enemy's power
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and control.

decisions.choice: a broad place: freedom and safety
decisions.reason: Room to move is the opposite of being hemmed in by distress (4:2; 18:20).

source.text: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר־לִ֥י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Be gracious to me, YHWH, for distress [is] to me; my eye has wasted away with grief, my soul and my belly.

en.L: Show me favor, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for I am hard pressed; my eye has wasted away with grief, my soul and my belly.
en.B: Have pity on me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for I am in trouble; grief has worn out my eyes, my whole self, my body.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, be kind to me, because I am in trouble. I have cried so much that my eyes are worn out. My whole body is weak from sadness.

fr.L: Fais-moi grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car je suis dans l’angoisse ; mon œil s’est consumé de chagrin, mon âme et mon ventre.
fr.B: Aie pitié de moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car je suis en détresse ; le chagrin a usé mes yeux, tout mon être, mon corps.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sois bon pour moi, parce que je suis dans le malheur. J’ai tellement pleuré que mes yeux sont usés. Tout mon corps est faible de tristesse.

sw.L: Unifanyie neema, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana niko katika dhiki; jicho langu limedhoofika kwa huzuni, nafsi yangu na tumbo langu.
sw.B: Unihurumie, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana niko taabuni; huzuni imeyachosha macho yangu, nafsi yangu yote, mwili wangu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unitendee wema, kwa sababu niko katika taabu. Nimelia sana hata macho yangu yamechoka. Mwili wangu wote umedhoofika kwa huzuni.

decisions.choice: wasted away: grown weak and dim
decisions.reason: The verb ('ashesh) is used of eyes worn out by grief in 6:8; here the whole person wastes away.

decisions.choice: my soul and my belly: my whole being, inside and out
decisions.reason: The soul (nefesh) and the belly (beten, the inner body) together are the whole person.

decisions.choice: my body
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the word stands for (m2).

source.text: כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְיָג֡וֹן חַיַּי֮ וּשְׁנוֹתַ֪י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּעֲוֺנִ֣י כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For my life is spent with sorrow and my years with sighing; my strength has stumbled because of my iniquity, and my bones have wasted away.

en.L: For my life is spent with sorrow and my years with sighing; my strength has stumbled because of my iniquity, and my bones have wasted away.
en.B: Sorrow is using up my life, and groaning my years; my guilt has made my strength give way, and my bones are wasting.
en.R: I am so sad that my life is slipping away. I groan year after year. My sins have made me weak, and my body is wasting away.

fr.L: Car ma vie s’achève dans le chagrin et mes années dans les soupirs ; ma force a trébuché à cause de ma faute, et mes os se sont consumés.
fr.B: Le chagrin use ma vie, et les gémissements mes années ; ma faute a fait fléchir ma force, et mes os dépérissent.
fr.R: Je suis si triste que ma vie s’en va. Je gémis année après année. Mes péchés m’ont rendu faible, et mon corps dépérit.

sw.L: Kwa maana maisha yangu yamekwisha kwa huzuni na miaka yangu kwa kuugua; nguvu zangu zimejikwaa kwa sababu ya uovu wangu, na mifupa yangu imedhoofika.
sw.B: Huzuni inayamaliza maisha yangu, na kuugua kunamaliza miaka yangu; hatia yangu imezifanya nguvu zangu ziishe, na mifupa yangu inadhoofika.
sw.R: Nina huzuni sana hata maisha yangu yanaisha. Ninaugua mwaka hadi mwaka. Dhambi zangu zimenidhoofisha, na mwili wangu unadhoofika.

decisions.choice: my iniquity: the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "because of my iniquity". The ancient Greek translation reads "in poverty", from a word very close in form, "my affliction". The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: my bones: my whole body
decisions.reason: As in 6:3.

source.text: מִכָּל־צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַ֨י׀מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Because of all my foes I have become a reproach, and to my neighbors exceedingly, and a dread to my acquaintances; those who see me in the street flee from me.

en.L: Because of all my foes I have become a reproach, and to my neighbors greatly so, and a dread to those who know me; those who see me in the street flee from me.
en.B: All my enemies have made me a disgrace, above all to my neighbors; the people I know are afraid of me, and when they see me outside they run from me.
en.R: All my enemies insult me. My neighbors look down on me most of all. My friends are afraid of me. When people see me on the street, they run away.

fr.L: À cause de tous mes adversaires je suis devenu un objet d’insulte, et pour mes voisins grandement, et un effroi pour ceux qui me connaissent ; ceux qui me voient dans la rue s’enfuient loin de moi.
fr.B: Tous mes ennemis ont fait de moi un objet de honte, surtout auprès de mes voisins ; les gens que je connais ont peur de moi, et quand ils me voient dehors, ils me fuient.
fr.R: Tous mes ennemis m’insultent. Mes voisins me méprisent plus que tous. Mes amis ont peur de moi. Quand les gens me voient dans la rue, ils s’en vont en courant.

sw.L: Kwa sababu ya watesi wangu wote nimekuwa aibu, na kwa jirani zangu zaidi sana, na kitisho kwa wanaonijua; wanaoniona njiani hunikimbia.
sw.B: Adui zangu wote wamenifanya kuwa aibu, hasa kwa jirani zangu; watu ninaowajua wananiogopa, na wanaponiona nje hunikimbia.
sw.R: Adui zangu wote wananitukana. Jirani zangu wananidharau kuliko wote. Rafiki zangu wananiogopa. Watu wanaponiona barabarani, wanakimbia.

decisions.choice: a reproach: an object of scorn
decisions.reason: The word (cherpah) is disgrace, being mocked and despised.

decisions.choice: exceedingly: above all
decisions.reason: The word (me'od) usually means "very"; here it seems to mean that the neighbors scorn him most of all. Some, changing a letter, read "a burden".

decisions.choice: a dread: someone people fear to be near
decisions.reason: His friends avoid him, as if his trouble might fall on them too.

source.text: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: I have been forgotten like a dead [one] from [the] heart; I have become like a perishing vessel.

en.L: I have been forgotten like a dead [person], out of [the] heart; I have become like a broken vessel.
en.B: People have put me out of their minds as if I had died; I am like a smashed pot.
en.R: People have forgotten me as if I were dead. I am like a broken pot that is thrown away.

fr.L: J’ai été oublié comme un mort, hors du cœur ; je suis devenu comme un vase brisé.
fr.B: On m’a chassé de sa mémoire comme si j’étais mort ; je suis comme un pot en miettes.
fr.R: Les gens m’ont oublié comme si j’étais mort. Je suis comme un pot cassé qu’on jette.

sw.L: Nimesahauliwa kama mfu, nje ya moyo; nimekuwa kama chombo kilichovunjika.
sw.B: Watu wameniondoa mawazoni mwao kana kwamba nimekufa; mimi ni kama chungu kilichovunjwa.
sw.R: Watu wamenisahau kana kwamba nimekufa. Mimi ni kama chungu kilichovunjika kinachotupwa.

decisions.choice: out of heart: out of mind
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought and memory; he is no longer thought of.

decisions.choice: a broken vessel: something thrown away
decisions.reason: A broken clay pot was useless and thrown out (Jeremiah 22:28).

source.text: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי׀דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For I have heard [the] whispering of many — terror [is] on every side — when they counsel together against me; to take my life they plot.

en.L: For I have heard the slander of many — terror all around! — when they consult together against me; to take my life they scheme.
en.B: I hear many people whispering lies — terror everywhere! — as they plan together against me, scheming to take my life.
en.R: I hear many people saying bad things about me. Everywhere I go, I am afraid. They are getting together and planning to kill me.

fr.L: Car j’ai entendu la calomnie de beaucoup — terreur tout autour ! — quand ils se concertent ensemble contre moi ; pour prendre ma vie ils complotent.
fr.B: J’entends beaucoup de gens chuchoter des mensonges — la terreur partout ! — tandis qu’ils se concertent contre moi et projettent de m’ôter la vie.
fr.R: J’entends beaucoup de gens dire du mal de moi. Partout où je vais, j’ai peur. Ils se réunissent et ils préparent un plan pour me tuer.

sw.L: Kwa maana nimesikia masingizio ya wengi — hofu kila upande! — wanaposhauriana pamoja juu yangu; wanapanga njama ya kuuondoa uhai wangu.
sw.B: Ninawasikia watu wengi wakinong'ona uongo — hofu kila mahali! — wanapopanga pamoja juu yangu, wakifanya hila ya kuniua.
sw.R: Ninawasikia watu wengi wakinisema vibaya. Kila ninakokwenda, ninaogopa. Wanakutana pamoja na kupanga kuniua.

decisions.choice: terror on every side: Jeremiah's words
decisions.reason: The same words (magor missaviv) are used by Jeremiah, who also heard many whispering against him (Jeremiah 6:25; 20:3, 10).

decisions.choice: terror all around: an outcry, or what they whisper
decisions.reason: The words may be the psalmist's cry, or the slogan his enemies whisper about him, as in Jeremiah 20:10.

decisions.choice: slander: evil whispering
decisions.reason: The word (dibbah) is a damaging report spread about someone.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֤י׀עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: But I, on you I trust, YHWH; I say, My God [are] you.

en.L: But I — in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I trust, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; I say, "My God [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: But I put my trust in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; I tell {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, "You alone are my God."
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I still trust {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. I keep saying, "You are my God!"

fr.L: Mais moi, en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} j’ai confiance, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; je dis : « Mon Dieu, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »
fr.B: Mais moi, je mets ma confiance en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dis : « C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul qui es mon Dieu. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai toujours confiance en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Je répète : « Tu es mon Dieu ! »

sw.L: Lakini mimi — {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ninatumaini, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; ninasema, "Mungu wangu [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}."
sw.B: Lakini mimi ninakutumaini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; ninakuambia, "Wewe peke {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ndiwe Mungu wangu."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, bado ninakutumaini. Ninaendelea kusema, "Wewe ni Mungu wangu!"

decisions.choice: But I ... you: emphatic
decisions.reason: Both pronouns are stressed: the psalmist, against all those plotting, and God, against every other help.

decisions.choice: alone
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the stress on "you" (m1).

source.text: בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד־א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: In your hand [are] my times; deliver me from [the] hand of my enemies and from my pursuers.

en.L: In {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand [are] my times; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from those who pursue me.
en.B: My whole life, every season of it, is in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand; rescue me from the power of my enemies and from those chasing me.
en.R: My life is in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands, from beginning to end. Save me from my enemies and from the people who are chasing me.

fr.L: Dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main [sont] mes temps ; délivre-moi de la main de mes ennemis et de ceux qui me poursuivent.
fr.B: Ma vie tout entière, chacun de ses moments, est dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main ; arrache-moi au pouvoir de mes ennemis et de ceux qui me pourchassent.
fr.R: Ma vie est entre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains, du début à la fin. Sauve-moi de mes ennemis et des gens qui me poursuivent.

sw.L: Mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}} [zimo] nyakati zangu; uniokoe kutoka katika mkono wa adui zangu na kutoka kwa wale wanaonifuatia.
sw.B: Maisha yangu yote, kila kipindi chake, yamo mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}; uniokoe kutoka katika nguvu za adui zangu na kutoka kwa wale wanaonifukuza.
sw.R: Maisha yangu yamo mikononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}, tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho. Uniokoe kutoka kwa adui zangu na kwa watu wanaonifukuza.

decisions.choice: my times: the course of my life
decisions.reason: The times of a person's life are all that happens in it (1 Chronicles 29:30). They are in God's hand, not the enemies'.

decisions.choice: your hand, the hand of my enemies: whose power?
decisions.reason: The verse sets God's hand against the enemies' hand; compare verse 6.

decisions.choice: my whole life, every season of it (B); my life, from beginning to end (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "my times" means (m1).

source.text: הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Make your face shine on your servant; save me in your loyal love.

en.L: Make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face shine on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant; save me in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love.
en.B: Turn the light of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face toward {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant; in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, save me.
en.R: Look on me with kindness, for I serve {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Save me because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love.

fr.L: Fais briller {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ; sauve-moi dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal.
fr.B: Tourne vers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur la lumière de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face ; dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, sauve-moi.
fr.R: Regarde-moi avec bonté, car je suis {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur. Sauve-moi, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle.

sw.L: Uangazishe uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} juu ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; uniokoe katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma.
sw.B: Uelekeze nuru ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, uniokoe.
sw.R: Unitazame kwa wema, kwa maana ninakutumikia. Uniokoe kwa sababu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma.

decisions.choice: make your face shine: the priestly blessing
decisions.reason: The words recall the blessing of Numbers 6:25, "the LORD make his face shine on you"; a shining face is favor (4:7; 80:4).

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps its commitments, the faithful kindness of the covenant (Exodus 34:6-7).

decisions.choice: Look on me with kindness
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, let me not be put to shame, for I have called to you; let [the] wicked be put to shame; let them be silent to Sheol.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, let me not be put to shame, for I have called on {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; let the wicked be put to shame; let them be silent in Sheol.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not let me be disgraced, for I have called to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; let the disgrace fall on the wicked; let them lie silent in Sheol.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I have called to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, so do not let me end up ashamed. Let wicked people be ashamed instead. Let them go to the place of the dead, where no one speaks.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que je ne sois pas couvert de honte, car je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai invoqué ; que les méchants soient couverts de honte ; qu’ils se taisent dans le Shéol.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne me laisse pas dans la honte, car j’ai crié vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; que la honte tombe sur les méchants ; qu’ils gisent en silence dans le séjour des morts.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai appelé : alors ne me laisse pas finir dans la honte. Que les méchants aient honte à ma place. Qu’ils aillent au séjour des morts, où personne ne parle.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nisiaibishwe, kwa maana nimekuita; waovu waaibishwe; wanyamazishwe Kuzimu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usiniache niaibishwe, kwa maana nimekulilia; aibu iwaangukie waovu; walale kimya Kuzimu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimekuita {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, kwa hiyo usiniache niishie kuaibika. Waovu ndio waaibike. Waende Kuzimu, mahali pa wafu, ambapo hakuna anayesema.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the world of the dead
decisions.reason: As in 6:6.

decisions.choice: be silent: be brought to silence
decisions.reason: The verb (damam) is to be still or silent; the lying lips of verse 19 will speak no more.

decisions.choice: be put to shame
decisions.reason: As in 25:2.

source.text: תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל־צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז׃

records.literal_gloss: Let [the] lips of falsehood be mute, which speak against [the] righteous insolence with pride and contempt.

en.L: May the lips of falsehood be struck dumb, that speak against the righteous [with] insolence, in pride and contempt.
en.B: May the lips that lie be struck dumb, lips that speak insolently against the righteous with pride and scorn.
en.R: Let liars lose the power to speak. They are proud, and they say cruel things about people who do what is right and look down on them.

fr.L: Qu’elles deviennent muettes, les lèvres de mensonge, qui parlent contre le juste [avec] insolence, avec orgueil et mépris.
fr.B: Que les lèvres menteuses soient réduites au silence, ces lèvres qui parlent avec insolence contre le juste, avec orgueil et dédain.
fr.R: Que les menteurs ne puissent plus parler. Ils sont orgueilleux, ils disent des choses méchantes sur ceux qui font ce qui est juste et ils les méprisent.

sw.L: Midomo ya uongo ifanywe bubu, inayosema juu ya mwenye haki [kwa] jeuri, kwa kiburi na dharau.
sw.B: Midomo inayosema uongo ifanywe bubu, midomo inayomsema mwenye haki kwa jeuri, kwa kiburi na dharau.
sw.R: Waongo wanyang'anywe uwezo wa kusema. Wana kiburi, na wanasema maneno ya ukatili juu ya watu wanaotenda haki, na kuwadharau.

decisions.choice: insolence: arrogant, reckless speech
decisions.reason: The word ('ataq) is bold, arrogant talk (75:6; 94:4).

decisions.choice: the righteous
decisions.reason: As in 1:5: those who do what is right; here the psalmist and those like him.

source.text: מָ֤ה רַֽב־טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר־צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם׃

records.literal_gloss: How great [is] your goodness which you have stored up for those fearing you, [which] you have worked for those taking refuge in you before [the] children of man.

en.L: How great [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} goodness, which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have stored up for those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, [which] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have worked for those who take refuge in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} before the {{gender:children of humankind|sons of men}}!
en.B: How great is the good {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep in store for those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, the good {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do, for all to see, to those who make {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} their refuge!
en.R: You are so good to people who honor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! You have saved up many good things for them. Everyone can see the good things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do for those who run to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for safety.

fr.L: Qu’elle est grande, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as mise en réserve pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent, [que] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as accomplie pour ceux qui se réfugient en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} devant les {{gender:enfants des humains|fils des hommes}} !
fr.B: Qu’il est grand, le bien que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gardes en réserve pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent, le bien que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais, sous les yeux de tous, à ceux qui font de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} leur refuge !
fr.R: Tu es si bon pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} respectent ! Tu as mis de côté beaucoup de bonnes choses pour eux. Tout le monde peut voir le bien que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais à ceux qui courent vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour être à l’abri.

sw.L: Jinsi ulivyo mkuu wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ambao umewawekea akiba wale wanaokucha, [ambao] umewatendea wale wanaokukimbilia mbele ya wanadamu!
sw.B: Jinsi ulivyo mkuu wema unaowawekea akiba wale wanaokucha, wema unaowatendea, mbele ya macho ya watu wote, wale wanaokufanya kuwa kimbilio lao!
sw.R: Wewe ni mwema sana kwa watu wanaokuheshimu! Umewawekea akiba mambo mengi mema. Kila mtu anaweza kuona mema unayowatendea wale wanaokukimbilia ili wawe salama.

decisions.choice: stored up: kept like treasure
decisions.reason: The verb (tsafan) is to hide away something precious (27:5).

decisions.choice: before the children of man: openly, for everyone to see
decisions.reason: What God has stored up in secret he gives in public.

decisions.choice: children of humankind, with "sons of men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in 11:4.

source.text: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם׀בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: You hide them in [the] hiding place of your presence from [the] plots of man; you conceal them in a shelter from [the] strife of tongues.

en.L: You hide them in the shelter of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence from the plots of {{gender:people|men}}; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} treasure them in a booth from the strife of tongues.
en.B: You hide them under the cover of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence, away from human plotting; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep them in a shelter, safe from quarrelsome tongues.
en.R: You keep them close to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, hidden from people who plan to hurt them. You protect them in a safe place from people who say cruel things about them.

fr.L: Tu les caches dans l’abri de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} présence, loin des complots {{gender:des humains|des hommes}} ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les mets en réserve dans une hutte, loin de la querelle des langues.
fr.B: Tu les caches à l’abri de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} présence, loin des intrigues humaines ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les gardes sous un abri, à l’écart des langues querelleuses.
fr.R: Tu les gardes près de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, cachés loin des gens qui veulent leur faire du mal. Tu les protèges dans un lieu sûr, loin de ceux qui disent des choses méchantes sur eux.

sw.L: Unawaficha katika sitara ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mbali na hila za watu; unawahifadhi katika kibanda mbali na ugomvi wa ndimi.
sw.B: Unawaficha chini ya kifuniko cha uwepo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, mbali na hila za wanadamu; unawaweka katika kibanda, salama mbali na ndimi za ugomvi.
sw.R: Unawaweka karibu {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}, wamefichwa mbali na watu wanaopanga kuwadhuru. Unawalinda mahali salama mbali na watu wanaowasema maneno ya ukatili.

decisions.choice: plots: schemes, conspiracies
decisions.reason: The word (rukhsim) is found only here; it seems to mean plots tied together against someone.

decisions.choice: the strife of tongues: slander and accusation
decisions.reason: Quarreling tongues are lying accusations (verses 14 and 19).

decisions.choice: a shelter: a booth, a covered place
decisions.reason: The word (sukkah) is a hut or booth that gives cover (27:5).

decisions.choice: people, with "men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word ('ish) means people in general here.

source.text: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדּ֥וֹ לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be] YHWH, for he has made wonderful his loyal love to me in a city of siege.

en.L: Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has shown {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love to me wonderfully in a city under siege.
en.B: Blessed is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has done a wonder of loyal love for me when I was in a city under siege.
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! He showed me {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love in an amazing way when I was trapped in a city with enemies all around.

fr.L: Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu merveilleux {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal envers moi dans une ville assiégée.
fr.B: Béni soit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui a fait pour moi une merveille d’amour fidèle quand j’étais dans une ville assiégée.
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Il m’a montré {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle d’une manière extraordinaire quand j’étais enfermé dans une ville entourée d’ennemis.

sw.L: Na abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana amenionyesha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma kwa ajabu katika mji uliozingirwa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} abarikiwe, kwa kuwa amenitendea ajabu ya upendo usiokoma nilipokuwa katika mji uliozingirwa na adui.
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Alinionyesha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma kwa njia ya ajabu nilipokuwa nimenaswa katika mji uliozungukwa na adui pande zote.

decisions.choice: a city under siege: hemmed in by enemies
decisions.reason: The words may describe a real siege, like David's danger at Keilah (1 Samuel 23), or picture the psalmist's distress as a city surrounded. Some read "a fortified city", a place of safety God gave him.

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps its commitments, the faithful kindness of the covenant (Exodus 34:6-7).

decisions.choice: Blessed: praised
decisions.reason: As in 28:6.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֤י׀אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, I said in my alarm, I am cut off from before your eyes; nevertheless you heard [the] sound of my pleas when I cried to you for help.

en.L: As for me, I said in my alarm, "I am cut off from before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes." But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} heard the sound of my pleadings when I cried to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for help.
en.B: In my panic I said, "I have been cut off, out of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sight." Yet {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} heard my voice as I pleaded for mercy and cried out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: I was so afraid that I said, "You have stopped looking after me!" But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} heard me when I begged {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for help.

fr.L: Quant à moi, j’ai dit dans mon affolement : « Je suis retranché de devant {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux. » Pourtant {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as entendu la voix de mes supplications quand je criais vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} au secours.
fr.B: Dans ma panique, je disais : « Je suis retranché, loin de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} regard. » Pourtant {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as entendu ma voix quand je demandais grâce et que je criais vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: J’avais si peur que j’ai dit : « Tu ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}occupes plus de moi ! » Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as entendu quand je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai supplié de m’aider.

sw.L: Na mimi, nilisema katika fadhaa yangu, "Nimekatiliwa mbali na mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}." Lakini ulisikia sauti ya maombi yangu nilipokulilia unisaidie.
sw.B: Katika hofu yangu nilisema, "Nimekatiliwa mbali, siko tena mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}." Hata hivyo ulisikia sauti yangu nilipokusihi unihurumie na kukulilia.
sw.R: Niliogopa sana hata nikasema, "Umeacha kunitunza!" Lakini ulinisikia nilipokusihi unisaidie.

decisions.choice: my alarm: my panic, my hurried flight
decisions.reason: The verb (chafaz) is to hurry away in fear; the same words are in 116:11.

decisions.choice: cut off: shut out of God's sight
decisions.reason: The verb (nigraz) is rare; he felt cut off from God's care.

decisions.choice: You have stopped looking after me
alternatives: I am cut off from before your eyes
decisions.reason: Readable says what the cry means (m2).

source.text: אֶֽהֱב֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל־חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל־יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Love YHWH, all his faithful ones! [The] faithful YHWH preserves, and repays in abundance [the] one acting [with] pride.

en.L: Love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful ones! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} guards the faithful, and repays in full the one who acts with pride.
en.B: Love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you who are loyal to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} watches over those who keep faith, but the one who acts proudly {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} repays in full measure.
en.R: All you people who are faithful to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} protects people who stay loyal to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives proud people all the punishment they deserve.

fr.L: Aimez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} garde les fidèles, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend avec abondance à celui qui agit avec orgueil.
fr.B: Aimez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} êtes fidèles ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veille sur ceux qui gardent la foi, mais à celui qui agit avec orgueil {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend pleinement ce qu’il mérite.
fr.R: Vous tous qui êtes fidèles {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, aimez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} protège ceux qui restent fidèles envers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne aux orgueilleux toute la punition qu’ils méritent.

sw.L: Mpendeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwalinda waaminifu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} humlipa kikamilifu yule atendaye kwa kiburi.
sw.B: Mpendeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote mlio waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwalinda wale wanaoshika uaminifu, lakini mtu atendaye kwa kiburi humlipa kwa kipimo kamili.
sw.R: Enyi watu wote mlio waaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mpendeni! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwalinda watu wanaobaki waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Lakini huwapa wenye kiburi adhabu yote wanayostahili.

decisions.choice: his faithful ones
decisions.reason: As in 30:5.

decisions.choice: the faithful: people who keep faith
decisions.reason: The word ('emunim) is used in 12:2 of people who can be relied on.

decisions.choice: in full: abundantly, more than enough
decisions.reason: The word (yeter) is what is left over, an abundance.

source.text: חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כָּל־הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Be strong and let your heart take courage, all who wait for YHWH.

en.L: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who wait for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Stand firm and be brave in heart, all of you who put your hope in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: All of you who are waiting for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to help you, be strong and brave!

fr.L: Soyez forts, et que votre cœur prenne courage, vous tous qui espérez en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Tenez bon et soyez courageux de cœur, vous tous qui mettez votre espoir en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Vous tous qui attendez que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vienne vous aider, soyez forts et courageux !

sw.L: Jitieni nguvu, na moyo wenu upate ujasiri, ninyi nyote mnaomngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Simameni imara na muwe na mioyo shujaa, ninyi nyote mnaoweka tumaini lenu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ninyi nyote mnaomngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, muwe hodari na jasiri!

decisions.choice: wait for: hope in
decisions.reason: The word (yachal) is to wait with hope.

decisions.choice: be strong and take courage
decisions.reason: Psalm 27 ends with the same call (27:14), here made to all who hope in the LORD.
